_about: Revision 2 (2026-10-25): corrected after re-verifying against data.cdb and diffing vs data_vanilla_2026-10-22.cdb; see VANILLA_MECHANICS_FOR_GINAZ.md corrections table.

candidates.name: Champion system (Ecaz)
candidates.growth: Army_OnEliminateFactionUnit_GainTTrait -> TEcazChampion_Buff_Stack (Hegemony 100 per stack, EcazChampion track)
candidates.ginaz_use: Name Champion (G-15) at 5K. Decide execute: vanilla champions are immune.
candidates.correction: Ability gated onlyForFactions=Ecaz and uses Ecaz-named hooks (Unit_EcazChampion, Faction_EcazChampion_GainTTrait). Untested for other factions.
